title: Omega-3 Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids in Youth With ADHD

sections.abstract: N-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids(N-3 PUFAs) is important in balancing the immune function and crucial for the developing brain. Deficiency in n-3 PUFAs might be linked to the poor cognitive performances resulting in inattention and hyperactivity in youth with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). N-3 PUFAs appears to be a promising treatment that is safe, beneficial to youth with ADHD. In this proposal, investigators aim the test the hypothesis that n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids will be more effective than placebo in improving cognitive function in youth with ADHD after 12 weeks of intervention.
